trap.label: deveria ter + particípio
trap.wrong: We should to have called the client earlier.
trap.right: We should have called the client earlier.
trap.why: Em português dizemos "deveria ter ligado" e o brasileiro insere to por analogia com infinitivo. Em inglês, depois de should have vem direto o particípio, sem to.

opts: arrependimento: não era para ter feito
mcq.why: shouldn't have + particípio lamenta algo que foi feito.

opts: You don't have to park here.

mcq.q: Complete: They recommend that every student **___** a copy.
Complete: **The fact ___** prices rose worried everyone.

fix.why: Of é erro de escrita por causa do som /əv/; a forma é have.

fix.wrong: She don't have to wear a uniform.
fix.right: She doesn't have to wear a uniform.

fix.wrong: They advise us to that apply early.
fix.right: They advise that we apply early.
fix.why: Escolha uma estrutura: advise that + sujeito + base.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com needn't: “We don't have to wait.”
Reescreva com suggest that: “You should see a dentist.”
rewrite.answer: I suggest that you see a dentist.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com that: “I have no evidence of his guilt.”
rewrite.answer: I have no evidence that he is guilty.
